description: This file defines the DispatcherActor class, an Akka actor responsible for dispatching signals and commands related to concierge service functionalities. It includes methods for creating dispatch flows, multiplexing different command types, and interfacing with other actors within the system.

classes.name: ImmutableDispatch
classes.description: Immutable inner class representing a dispatch message along with its sender and associated aggregator actor within the DispatcherActor context.

methods.name: createDispatchFlow
methods.description: Creates a graph representing the flow for dispatching search and retrieve commands through multiplexing and sink processing.

methods.name: multiplexBy
methods.description: Creates a filter for multiplexing messages based on specified command classes.

methods.name: searchActorSink
methods.description: Creates a sink that enforces preconditions and then forwards dispatches to the search actor.

methods.name: thingsAggregatorSink
methods.description: Creates a sink that enforces preconditions and then forwards dispatches to the things aggregator actor.

methods.name: preEnforce
methods.description: Helper method to apply pre-enforcement logic asynchronously before proceeding with message forwarding.

methods.name: initActor
methods.description: Initializes actor registration and checks correct actor path configuration.

methods.name: sanityCheck
methods.description: Verifies that the actor's path matches the expected configured path.

methods.name: putSelfToPubSubMediator
methods.description: Registers this actor with the pub-sub mediator for cluster communication.
